call_purpose: You had connected your payment gateway, but your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they buy.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and a test order you placed produced the confirmation email in your inbox.

covered.text: We explained that the default sender name on the email can be changed under Email settings, Sender name. This is not yet done.

customer_next_steps.text: Change the sender name to your brand name under Email settings, Sender name.
